title: Fruit of the Spirit
definition: The fruit of the Spirit is the Christlike character produced by the Holy Spirit in the life of a believer.
summary: The Spirit forms love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness, gentleness, and self-control in God's people.
christFocus: The fruit of the Spirit reflects the character of Jesus Christ being formed within His people.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: The Spirit forms love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness, gentleness, and self-control in God's people.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers know God rightly, follow Christ faithfully, and avoid confusion in doctrine and daily life.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, compare it with Scripture, bring it into prayer, and let it shape your worship, obedience, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
